prerequisites: Knowledge equivalent to high school mathematics

learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire the basic mathematical knowledge from analysis, linear algebra, and number theory necessary for the management of AI systems.
Students gain an overview of the mathematical modes of thinking and working in Artificial Intelligence, primarily using practical examples.
Students acquire formal and mathematical competence, enabling them to formally describe problems.
Students successfully apply their mathematical knowledge to solve formal tasks.
Students are able to use suitable mathematical tools such as a computer algebra system or a spreadsheet program to solve problems.
Through group work, students learn cooperation skills.
Students have basic knowledge of mathematical modeling in the field of Artificial Intelligence.
Students have an insight into solving problems through group work and teamwork.

Students have in-depth knowledge of mathematical methods for processing practical tasks (treatment of complex relationships with matrices, linear equation systems, functions of (several) variables as a basis for understanding models).
Students are capable of in-depth personal time management and self-study, as they develop approximately 50% of the material through virtual learning.

syllabus_topics: Logic and Boolean Algebra as well as Proof by Induction
Linear and Nonlinear Functions and their Properties
Differentiation (Differentiation Rules, Higher Derivatives, Curve Discussion)
Rules for Integration (Partial Integration, Substitution Rule, Partial Fraction Decomposition)
Differential Calculus for Functions with Several Independent Variables
Linear and Nonlinear Functions with Several Independent Variables
Vector Spaces, Basis and Linear Equation Systems
Gaussian Algorithm for Solving Linear Equation Systems
assessment_rules: The examination is a written test of 90 minutes. The weighting of the grade for this module is 5/210 for the overall degree. Approximately 50% of the material is covered through virtual teaching.
